data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'hæstingas', Hastings originally meant 'people of the horse'. The name carries a sense of strength, power, and mobility. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hastings usually hope their child will grow to embody horse people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
